ask.text:
The wall is in shadow and Hannu is there, which means he was always going to be.

"The palace needs a thing carried to the island and not written down. A seal. You will show it to Kinyras and say nothing else, and if it is asked for, you never had it."

what.text: "For a man to know that the palace remembers him." He holds out a small pouch without quite touching it. "That is all you need, and more than you want."

refuse.text: "Then forget the gate, and the gate will forget you." He is already walking away. "Do not come back at the second hour."
